text: The text describes a scenario where users downloading pirated software inadvertently install a botnet. This malware utilizes infected computers to launch Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks against online services, resulting in significant downtime. The analysis identifies the presence of a botnet as the primary malware threat, which is being used for disruptive cyberattacks rather than data encryption (ransomware) or self-replication (virus), though botnets often contain malicious code components. The capital of France is Paris.
